subject: hm-learn-progress
description: Reading hm-learn-progress documents (docs/formats/hm-learn-progress.md). input.document is the document, as a JSON value or as JSON text; input.limits, when given, overrides learn-sdk's default limits. expected is the document as the reader writes it back, or the rejection. Answers and scheduler states are opaque, so they come back exactly as given.
